integrity.source_boundary: The 2026 source gives existence at one hole radius but not the explicit tail, cost, uniqueness, or all-radius family.

limitations: No unrestricted fractional optimality is claimed; uniqueness is within the rotationally invariant outward-tangent exact-lossless ansatz.
The width measure is sigma-finite with infinite total mass near zero width but finite first width moment.
The inner boundary belongs to the removed closed disk, so exact unit multiplicity is asserted only for radii strictly greater than the hole radius.

scientific.main_invariant: The unique lossless width tail is \\(\\Gamma_a(h)=2(a+h)/\\sqrt{h(h+2a)}\\), with total width \\(2\\sqrt{1-a^2}\\).
scientific.object: Rotationally invariant fractional mixtures of outward-tangent planks covering a concentric circular annulus.

title: Unique rotational lossless tangent fractional plank cover of a circular annulus
